note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 6.1 and HEAD code (coa.go admitRequest, isAllowedSource). TestCoASourceFilterDiscardsWhenNoServerResolved and TestCoASourceFilterAnswersAConfiguredClient prove an empty allowlist silently discards an otherwise valid CoA-Request while a configured loopback allowlist processes it (CoA-NAK). TestRFC5176UntrustedSourceDiscarded proves an otherwise valid Disconnect-Request for a live session is silently discarded with zero teardowns under both a non-matching allowlist (192.0.2.1) and an empty allowlist, while a loopback-trusting listener answers Disconnect-ACK.
